title: Provincial campaign under new constitutional rules
detail: Parties and social blocs mobilized around tenancy, representation, and provincial authority in a redesigned electoral field.

title: Fragmented election results require coalition bargaining
detail: No single bloc consolidated full control, forcing negotiated coalition politics to form government in Bengal.

title: Coalition-era tensions feed later constitutional realignments
detail: The limits of provincial coalition governance shaped political positions that became central by the 1940 Lahore Resolution and beyond.
